mapper.sql: r.id, r.review_id, r.input_revision, r.request_key, r.request_hash, r.status, r.failure_code, r.runner_instance_id, r.started_at, r.finished_at
mapper.select: SELECT input_revision FROM combination_review WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM combination_review_run r WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId} AND r.request_key = #{requestKey}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM combination_review_run WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO combination_review_run (review_id, input_revision, request_key, request_hash, status, input_json, runner_instance_id, started_at) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{inputRevision}, #{requestKey}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{inputJson}, #{runnerInstanceId}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE combination_review_run SET evidence_json = #{evidenceJson} WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND evidence_json IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO combination_review_run_source (run_id, document_index, raw_hash, raw_bytes) VALUES (#{runId}, #{documentIndex}, #{rawHash}, #{rawBytes})
mapper.select: SELECT s.run_id, s.document_index, s.raw_hash, s.raw_bytes FROM combination_review_run_source s INNER JOIN combination_review_run r ON r.id = s.run_id INNER JOIN combination_review c ON c.id = r.review_id WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId} AND r.id = #{runId} AND c.owner_account_id = #{ownerId} AND s.document_index = #{documentIndex}
mapper.update: UPDATE combination_review_run SET configuration_json = #{configurationJson} WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND configuration_json IS NULL
UPDATE combination_review_run SET status = #{status}, analysis_json = #{analysisJson}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
